snippet.title: Flame Keeper | PlayStation 5 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Flame Keeper is coming to PlayStation 5 on July 25th! 🔥

🔥 Wishlist now on PlayStation to be ready for launch:
👉 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014792

Become Ignis — the fiercest little coal with the biggest punches — and fight back against the darkness consuming Orbis!
Dash, smash, upgrade, and restore the Eternal Flame in this fiery, action-packed roguelike adventure.

#FlameKeeper #PS5 #Roguelike #IndieGame #GamingTrailer #WishlistNow
